text: Adolescent mental health issues are increasingly prominent, making early screening essential for intervention. Schools, as the primary environment for adolescents, serve as ideal settings for screening programs. Parents, as key decision-makers, directly influence participation through their willingness. This study aimed to assess parents’ acceptance of school-based mental health screening among Chinese middle school students, identified relevant factors and concerns, with the goal of providing valuable insights for future programs.
source_label: Parental willingness and influencing factors for school-based mental health screening in Eastern China
